## The Hope Diamond’s Two-Day Journey to the Smithsonian

In 1958, jeweler Harry Winston donated the 45.5-carat Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian. It began its journey from New York on November 8, sent from the city’s General Post Office in a plain brown package by registered first-class mail.

The postage cost $2.44, and registration cost $142.85. The diamond arrived at the Smithsonian on November 10. Its arrival was marked by a presentation ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
